extension.summary: Watched status, resume points and watchlists kept in Kodi, with TMDb lists
extension.description: Keeps track of what you watch without a server: watched status, resume points, Next Up and your watchlist live in a small database inside Kodi. Lists include Continue Watching, Next Up, In Progress, Watchlist and Recently Watched, plus Trending, Popular and Top Rated from TMDb, search and genres. Every list can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and videos started elsewhere, such as from a skin, are tracked too.
extension.disclaimer: Artwork, details, search and the TMDb lists need a free TMDb API key (Settings, TMDb).
extension.news: 0.1.12: Import from Trakt: history, watched movies and shows, watchlist and resume points, from a JSON export or a zip (Settings, Tracking, Import watch history) 0.1.11: Sync: keep watched status, resume points and the watchlist the same on your Kodi devices at home, with no server (Settings, Sync: pair devices with a code; any number of them, each removable) 0.1.10: After an update, shows refresh and widgets reload at once (new details show without waiting a day); show refreshes no longer wait for background trailers 0.1.9: Shows show how much is watched (episodes out), and Coming Soon / New Episodes for skins; In Progress includes shows you have caught up on with an episode on its way 0.1.8: Under skin.ultra, episodes not out yet show as not playable 0.1.7: Under skin.ultra, Kodi's context menu plays get the skin's loading screen; Play from beginning plays from the start; the context menu entries are under one Tally entry 0.1.6: Works with TMDb Helper: install TMDbHelper Sync - Tally to sync watched status, resume points, Next Up and the watchlist both ways. 0.1.5: Every list shows resume points, and a resume chosen in the skin (Resume / Play from beginning) is not asked again when the video starts 0.1.4: Plays pass the movie's IMDb id (and a show's IMDb and TVDb ids), so sources like Torrentio find it; movies not out to watch at home yet are left out of the TMDb lists (setting in Lists). 0.1.3: Logos TMDb stores as SVG (e.g. Stranger Things) now load: they're fetched as PNG, which Kodi can draw. 0.1.2: Poster, fanart, logo and episode image sizes in the new Images settings (posters now w342, faster on TVs); widgets reload once after artwork is fetched instead of repeatedly. 0.1.1: Path picker lists installed player files with their add-ons' icons, including ones add-ons ship themselves (no TMDb Helper needed). 0.1.0: First version: local watched status, resume points, Next Up and watchlist; TMDb trending, popular, top rated, search and genres.
